# Approvals page: queue of planned runs, Approve and Request changes ## What to build A new **Approvals** page in graph-manager's React UI (`apps/graph-manager/src/web`) where the admin reviews runs that the engine planned and stopped at `awaiting-approval`, across all workspaces: - A nav item **Approvals** (right after Runs) with a count badge of runs in `awaiting-approval` (from the overview poll of `GET /api/runs`; no badge at 0). Route `/approvals`, command-palette entry, g-chord `g a`. - One row per awaiting run: the workspace (forge chip + `owner/repo`), the run id (link to `/runs/:ws/:runId`), the refs as links (`KAN-41 ↗`), the planned spec's title with a **View spec** toggle that opens the spec inline in the existing spec viewer (`SpecView`), the number of planned tasks (and their titles in the expanded view), the age, and two actions: **Approve** and **Request changes**. Request changes opens a textarea; its **Send** button is disabled while the feedback is blank. - A small server route that serves the planned spec and task list of a run: `GET /api/runs/:ws/:runId/plan` (cookie). The planned files are committed on the run's integration branch, not in the workspace checkout, so the existing `GET /api/workspaces/:id/specs/file` can't read them. Approve calls `POST /api/runs/:ws/:runId/approve`; Request changes calls `POST /api/runs/:ws/:runId/reject {feedback}`. After either, the row shows a toast, the overview refreshes, and the run leaves the queue once its status changes. ### What is already in the code (dependencies) - **Engine**: runs started with `--content` plan first; with the gate on they stop at status `awaiting-approval` (process exited). `state.json` (`stateSchema` from `graph-execution/api`) has `plan: { contentPath, refs: [{ref, url?, title?}], gate, name?, attempts, questions, dropped, feedback }`; once planned, `plan.name` is set and `docs/prd/.md` + `.agents/tasks//*.json` (+ `test-plan.json`) are committed on `state.integrationBranch` = `graph/` (commit `Plan: `). `state.specPath` / `state.tasksDir` then hold the repo paths `/docs/prd/.md` / `/.agents/tasks/`, but until the run is applied those files exist only on that branch and in its worktree `/worktrees/integration/`, **not in the workspace checkout**. `graph-execution/api` exports `planSpecRel(name)` and `planTasksRel(name)` (the git paths). `plan` also has `error?: string`. - **Server actions** (`src/server/run-actions.ts`, cookie routes): `POST /api/runs/:ws/:runId/approve` → 200 + run object (409 `the run is not awaiting approval (status )` otherwise); `POST /api/runs/:ws/:runId/reject {feedback}` → 200 + run object, 400 for blank feedback, 409 when not awaiting. They resume the engine with `--approve-plan` / `--replan `. - **Run summaries** (`GET /api/runs`, `src/server/runs.ts` `RunSummary`, mirrored in `src/web/types.ts`): `status` can be `planning | needs-info | awaiting-approval`; `refs?: {ref, url?, title?}[]`, `questions?`, `dropped?`, `prError?`. `src/web/ui/status.ts` has chips for the new statuses (`awaiting-approval` → tone `rev`, glyph `half`). `src/web/ui/RefLinks.tsx` exports `RefLinks({ refs })` rendering `A ↗` links (with `stopPropagation`). - **Run objects** (`src/server/v1-runs.ts`): `findRun`, `toRunObject`, `detailUrlOf`. ## Context: files to read before implementing - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/App.tsx` (lines 64–84) — routes; add `} />`. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/Shell.tsx` (14–24 `useNavCounts`; 28 `CHORD`; 43–54 `NavItem`; 154–183 the nav links) — add the item and the count. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/CommandPalette.tsx` (line ~53) — page entries (`{ id: "p:reviewers", group: "Pages", icon: "review", label: "Reviewers", secondary: "page", to: "/reviewers" }`). - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/ui/Icon.tsx` (lines 3–30 `IconName`, 32–125 `PATHS`) — add a `check` icon: `check: `. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/overview.tsx` (10–27 `Overview`, `useOverview()`, `refresh()`) — the runs list every page reads. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Runs.tsx` (142–206 `RunRow`, 208–232 `GroupHeader` with `ForgeChip`) and `Runs.css` — table/row classes to reuse (`table-row`, `runs-pill`, `runs-failure`, `btn btn-sm`). - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/components/SpecView.tsx` — the existing spec viewer: `` (`resolved` from `useTheme()` in `src/web/ui/theme.ts`). - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Settings.tsx` (36–171) — form, `busy`, `field-error` pattern; `src/web/ui/toast.tsx` (`useToast().show({ tone, text })`). - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/ui/EmptyState.tsx` — empty page state. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/api.ts` — `api()`, `post()`, `ApiError`. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/specs.ts` (lines 96–132) — the spec file route to mirror (no-store header, 404 shapes, size cap `MAX_SPEC_BYTES`). - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/runs.ts` (396–409 private `git(ws, args)` helper with `execa`, `taskTitle` 303–309, `readRunStateOf`, `isRunId`). - Tests to mirror: `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Runs.test.tsx` (1–80: `run()` factory, fetch stub, `MemoryRouter` + `OverviewProvider` + `ToastProvider`), `apps/graph-manager/src/web/Shell.test.tsx` (line 131) and `apps/graph-manager/src/web/App.test.tsx` (line 28) — both assert the exact nav labels `["Runs", "Terminals", "Workspaces", "Reviewers", "Settings"]` and must be updated to include `"Approvals"` after `"Runs"`. Server: `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/specs.test.ts`, `routes/pr.test.ts` (56–78 writing a run's `state.json`). ## Patterns to follow **Server route (mirror routes/specs.ts 104–131):** ```ts app.get<{ Params: { ws: string; runId: string } }>("/api/runs/:ws/:runId/plan", async (req, reply) => { reply.header("cache-control", "no-store"); if (!isRunId(req.params.runId)) return reply.code(400).send({ error: "invalid run id" }); const ws = resolveWorkspace(ctx.config.workspacesDir, req.params.ws); if (!ws) return reply.code(404).send({ error: "unknown workspace" }); const state = await readRunStateOf(ws, req.params.runId); if (!state) return reply.code(404).send({ error: "unknown run" }); if (!state.plan?.name) return reply.code(404).send({ error: "the run has no plan" }); ... }); ``` **Reading committed files without a checkout:** `git show :` and `git ls-tree --name-only /` with `execa("git", args, { cwd: ws.path, reject: false, stdin: "ignore", timeout: 10_000, env: { ...process.env, GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT: "0" } })` (mirror `runs.ts` 396–409). `` = `state.integrationBranch`; reject a branch name starting with `-`. **Web page skeleton:** a default-export function component `Approvals()` in `src/web/pages/Approvals.tsx` with its own `Approvals.css`; `
` and an `

Approvals

` header like Settings.tsx 177–183. ## Step-by-step tasks ### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/plan.ts` (register in `app.ts`) - **IMPLEMENT**: `planRoutes(app, ctx)` with `GET /api/runs/:ws/:runId/plan` → `200 { name, spec: { path: "docs/prd/.md", title, text } | null, tasks: [{ id, title }], refs, questions, dropped, feedback }`: - `spec.text` = `git show :` (null when it fails); `title` = `taskTitle(text) ?? name`; refuse a text over `MAX_SPEC_BYTES` (import from `./specs.js`) → `spec: null` plus `specError: "spec is larger than 1 MiB"`. - `tasks`: `git ls-tree --name-only /` → the `*.json` names except `test-plan.json`; for each `git show` the file, `JSON.parse`, `id` = its `id` field or the file name without `.json`, `title` = `taskTitle(content) ?? id`; sort by id numerically (`localeCompare(b, undefined, { numeric: true })`). A file that fails to parse is listed with `title: id`. - Fallback when git fails (branch gone): read the same relative paths from the integration worktree `path.join(runDirOf(ws, runId), "worktrees", "integration", ...rel.split("/"))`, then from the checkout (`state.specPath` / `state.tasksDir`, present there once the run is applied). Never read `state.specPath` first: before apply it points at a file the checkout doesn't have. - `refs`, `questions`, `dropped`, `feedback` from `state.plan` (default `[]`). - **GOTCHA**: `plan.name` comes from an agent: accept it only when it matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,99}$`, else `404 the run has no plan`. Never pass user input to git as an option. - **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/routes/plan.test.ts` ### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/plan.test.ts` - **IMPLEMENT** (`appWithLogin()`; a git repo workspace at `config.workspacesDir/github/octo/hello` with one commit on `main`; create branch `graph/` with `git checkout -q -b graph/`, add `docs/prd/hello-feature.md` (`# Hello feature\n\nBody`), `.agents/tasks/hello-feature/1.json` (`{"id":"1","content":"# Say hello\n\nWrite hello.txt","dependencies":[]}`) and `test-plan.json`, commit, `git checkout -q main`; write `.graph-execution//state.json` via `stateSchema.parse` with `status: "awaiting-approval"`, `integrationBranch: "graph/"`, `plan: { contentPath: "x", refs: [{ref:"A"}], gate: true, name: "hello-feature", attempts: 1, questions: [], dropped: [], feedback: [] }`): - GET `/api/runs/github~octo~hello//plan` → 200 with `spec.title === "Hello feature"`, `spec.text` containing `Body`, `tasks` equal to `[{ id: "1", title: "Say hello" }]` (no test-plan), `refs` `[{ref:"A"}]`; the workspace checkout has no `docs/prd/hello-feature.md`. - A run without `plan.name` → 404; a `plan.name` of `../x` → 404; unknown run → 404; without the cookie → 401. - **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/routes/plan.test.ts` ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/types.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: `export interface RunPlan { name: string; spec: { path: string; title: string; text: string } | null; specError?: string; tasks: { id: string; title: string }[]; refs: { ref: string; url?: string; title?: string }[]; questions: { ref?: string; questions: string[] }[]; dropped: string[]; feedback: string[] }`. ### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Approvals.tsx` and `Approvals.css` - **IMPLEMENT**: - `const waiting = runs.filter((r) => r.type === "run" && r.status === "awaiting-approval")` from `useOverview()`, oldest first (they have waited longest). Before the first poll (`!loaded`) show `SkeletonRows`; none → `EmptyState` "Nothing waits for approval." with a hint "Runs started with a plan gate stop here after planning.". - Each row is an `ApprovalRow` (`data-testid="approval--"`): it loads `GET /api/runs///plan` once on mount (`encodeURIComponent` both parts); shows forge chip + `fullPath` (from `workspaces` of `useOverview()`, else the id), `` with the run id, ``, the spec title, `" task(s)"` (`data-testid="approval-task-count"`), and `relativeTime(run.createdAt)`. A plan load error shows `Couldn't load the plan: ` and keeps the buttons. - **View spec** button (`aria-expanded`, `data-testid="approval-view-spec"`) toggles an inline panel with `` and the task list (`
    ` of `id title`). Disabled when `plan.spec` is null. - **Approve** (`btn btn-primary btn-sm`, `data-testid="approval-approve"`): `post("/api/runs/" + enc(ws) + "/" + enc(runId) + "/approve")`; success → toast `{ tone: "ok", text: "Approved " + runId }` and `refresh()`; failure → toast `{ tone: "bad", text: "Couldn't approve: " + message }`.
